title: Leveraging Neuroleadership and Adopting AI to Improve Human Capital Development in IT&C Business Organisations
impact: 10 representatives of Romanian IT&C companies (focus group) - exploratory, single-sector
ends: Accelerate AI adoption via neuro-leadership principles
Foster a culture of continuous learning; mitigate AI risks
Sustainable competitive advantage amid technological change

verbatims.text: This paper aims to explore how business organisations in the Romanian IT&C sector strategically implement neuro-leadership principles to accelerate the adoption... of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies...
Applying the focus group method, dynamic discussions were held with 10 representatives of Romanian IT&C companies...
The results of the research, divided into four main themes, reveal the importance of neuroleadership in improving employee competencies...
...the results reveal the importance of fostering a culture of continuous learning and development to harness the potential benefits of AI...
